label: scam
title: 'Your Social Security number is linked to drug smuggling' -- deposit cash in a Bitcoin ATM
sources: FTC Data Spotlight Aug 2025: 'False alarm, real scam' -- accounts/SSN 'compromised'
FTC Data Spotlight Sep 2024: Bitcoin ATMs as a payment portal for scammers

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the Social Security Administration. Your Social Security number was found in a car with drugs at the border.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your bank accounts will be frozen within the hour. To protect your money, you must withdraw it and deposit it in a Bitcoin ATM.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I've never used one of those.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll stay on the phone and walk you through it at the gas station. Don't hang up and don't speak to anyone in the store.
